entries.title: I Chronicles 17:1
segments: ¶Now it came to pass, when David was dwelling in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, "See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD [is] under tent curtains."

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:2
segments: Then Nathan said to David, "Do all that [is] in your heart, for God [is] with you."

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:3
segments: But it happened that night that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:4
segments: "Go and tell My servant David, 'Thus says the LORD: "You shall not build Me a house to dwell in.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:5
segments: "For I have not dwelt in a house since the time that I brought up Israel, even to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from [one] tabernacle [to another].

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:6
segments: "Wherever I have moved about with all Israel, have I ever spoken a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to shepherd My people, saying, 'Why have you not built Me a house of cedar?'"'

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:7
segments: "Now therefore, thus shall you say to My servant David, 'Thus says the LORD of hosts: "I took you from the sheepfold, from following the sheep, to be ruler over My people Israel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:8
segments: "And I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you, and have made you a name like the name of the great men who [are] on the earth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:9
segments: "Moreover I will appoint a place for My people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own and move no more; nor shall the sons of wickedness oppress them anymore, as previously,

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:10
segments: "since the time that I commanded judges [to be] over My people Israel. Also I will subdue all your enemies. Furthermore I tell you that the LORD will build you a house.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:11
segments: "And it shall be, when your days are fulfilled, when you must go [to be] with your fathers, that I will set up your seed after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:12
segments: "He shall build Me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:13
segments: "I will be his Father, and he shall be My son; and I will not take My mercy away from him, as I took [it] from [him] who was before you.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:14
segments: "And I will establish him in My house and in My kingdom forever; and his throne shall be established forever."'"

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:15
segments: According to all these words and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:16
segments: ¶Then King David went in and sat before the LORD; and he said: "Who [am] I, O LORD God? And what is my house, that You have brought me this far?

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:17
segments: "And [yet] this was a small thing in Your sight, O God; and You have [also] spoken of Your servant's house for a great while to come, and have regarded me according to the rank of a man of high degree, O LORD God.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:18
segments: "What more can David [say] to You for the honor of Your servant? For You know Your servant.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:19
segments: "O LORD, for Your servant's sake, and according to Your own heart, You have done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:20
segments: "O LORD, [there is] none like You, nor [is there any] God besides You, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:21
segments: "And who [is] like Your people Israel, the one nation on the earth whom God went to redeem for Himself [as] a people-to make for Yourself a name by great and awesome deeds, by driving out nations from before Your people whom You redeemed from Egypt?

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:22
segments: "For You have made Your people Israel Your very own people forever; and You, LORD, have become their God.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:23
segments: "And now, O LORD, the word which You have spoken concerning Your servant and concerning his house, [let it] be established forever, and do as You have said.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:24
segments: "So let it be established, that Your name may be magnified forever, saying, 'The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, [is] Israel's God.' And let the house of Your servant David be established before You.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:25
segments: "For You, O my God, have revealed to Your servant that You will build him a house. Therefore Your servant has found it [in his heart] to pray before You.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:26
segments: "And now, LORD, You are God, and have promised this goodness to Your servant.

entries.title: I Chronicles 17:27
segments: "Now You have been pleased to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue before You forever; for You have blessed it, O LORD, and [it shall be] blessed forever."
